# CTD Studio (code-to-diagram)

> Code-first diagrams you can still hand-tune: dragged node positions and 3-point connector handles are stored separately from source code by stable IDs, so manual layouts survive code edits. Local-first browser editor and MCP server (`ctd-mcp` v1.2.0) with full Mermaid (v12.3.0) runtime plus built-in translators for Graphviz DOT, PlantUML, D2, SQL DDL, TypeScript, and XML (Draw.io, BPMN, generic XML).

## Canonical Pages
- Home: https://code-to-diagram.vercel.app/
- Interactive Studio Workbench: https://code-to-diagram.vercel.app/app
- Syntax & Template Docs: https://code-to-diagram.vercel.app/docs
- Privacy & Cookies: https://code-to-diagram.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms of Use (Elastic License 2.0): https://code-to-diagram.vercel.app/terms
- Repository: https://github.com/cxernlol/code-to-diagram

## Key Capabilities
- **7 Input Formats:** Mermaid (v12.3.0), Graphviz DOT, PlantUML, D2, SQL DDL, TypeScript, and XML (Draw.io, BPMN, generic XML).
- **Interactive Canvas:** Drag boxes, adjust 3-point connector handles (start, middle, end/arrow), snap to grid, switch themes/looks (`classic` / `handDrawn`), and export SVG or PNG.
- **Local-First Privacy:** Zero cookies, IndexedDB local storage (`sgs-studio`), and optional client-side BYOK AI refinement.
- **MCP Server (`ctd-mcp` v1.2.0):** Run via `npx -y ctd-mcp` for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, and Antigravity (`detect_format`, `to_mermaid`, `translate_format`, `parse_diagram_ir`, `emit_from_ir`, `list_templates`, `get_studio_info`, `configure_mermaid_diagram`).
